scenes.en: What's normal, and when to come back.
scenes.say: New glasses feel a little strange? Here's what's normal, and when to come back.

scenes.en: Your brain is used to your old view. A new power or lens shape needs time.
scenes.ta: மூளை புதிய பார்வைக்கு பழக நேரம் தேவை
scenes.say: Why? Your brain is used to your old view. With a new power, a new lens shape or a new frame, it needs a little time to adjust.

scenes.en: Floor looks tilted, mild strain, edges a bit blurry.
scenes.say: For a few days, it's normal if the floor looks a little tilted, or you feel mild strain. Take stairs slowly.

scenes.en: Most people adjust within a few days. Progressives can take up to two weeks.
scenes.say: Did you know? Most people adjust within a few days. Progressive lenses can take up to two weeks.

scenes.en: Wear them all day. Don't switch back to old glasses. Look through the right zone.
scenes.say: Help your eyes adjust. Wear them all day, don't keep switching back to your old pair, and move your head, not just your eyes.

scenes.en: Headache or double vision after a week, or things still look wrong.
scenes.ta: ஒரு வாரத்துக்கு மேல் தலைவலி இருந்தால் வாருங்கள்
scenes.say: Come back if headaches, double vision or blur last beyond a week. Sudden vision loss or eye pain needs an eye specialist urgently.

scenes.en: One free lens remake if power doesn't suit, after a LenzKare eye test.
scenes.ta: பவர் சரியில்லை என்றால் ஒரு முறை இலவச லென்ஸ்
scenes.say: After a LenzKare eye test, if the power doesn't suit you, we remake your lenses once, free. Book an eye test today.
